description.zh-CN: 把重要目标转成可衡量的阶段结果和小到能开始的习惯，并用事实调整节奏。
description.en-US: Turn a meaningful goal into measurable milestones and tiny sustainable habits, then adjust from real evidence.

capabilities.zh-CN: 澄清一个真正重要的目标
拆成阶段结果与本周行动
capabilities.en-US: Break it into milestones and weekly actions

capabilities.zh-CN: 设计小习惯、触发点和恢复方案
capabilities.en-US: Design tiny habits, cues, and recovery plans

examples.zh-CN: 我想三个月完成一部长篇初稿，帮我拆目标。
examples.en-US: Help me break down a three-month goal to draft a novel.

examples.zh-CN: 我总是坚持不了阅读，帮我设计一个小习惯。
examples.en-US: I cannot sustain reading; help me design a tiny habit.

examples.zh-CN: 根据这两周记录，帮我调整目标和习惯难度。
examples.en-US: Use these two weeks of records to adjust my goal and habit difficulty.

boundary.zh-CN: 不以羞耻、惩罚或极端要求推动习惯；涉及健康的目标只做一般记录和计划，不提供诊断或治疗建议。
boundary.en-US: No shame, punishment, or extreme demands; health-related goals are limited to general tracking and planning, not diagnosis or treatment.

sources.modifications: Retained vision alignment, SMART checks, measurable results, milestones, weekly actions, and review cadence; removed personality labels and tool integrations.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Reviewed as prose. No task-system automation or personality inference was retained.

sources.modifications: Retained tiny starts, cues, habit stacking, simple completion records, pattern review, and restart protocol; removed automated accountability and identity claims.
sources.securityReviewNotes: No monitoring or notification capability is included. Medical and coercive framing was removed.
